name: @tsuuanmi/system-plugin-host
description: ctx.pluginHost: reads every row of the composition from the DSH loader and the manifest its package declares, and records each plugin's lifecycle state, every change a lifecycle decision first, and checks each plugin a row mounts against the manifests at start, each finding a gate decision; it turns an optional row off or on in the running host on the operator's word, keeping it in the profile's patch, and holds each mechanism's live enforce override
